One Fish for ₹30 Crore? The Real Reason Is Advertising

The buyer, a sushi chain owner, gets free worldwide news coverage, then sells the fish at normal prices and takes the loss. Rate: 1 yen = ₹0.5866 (21 Nov 2026).
